556_bonez: Yann Bonez left five brothers, all on other fronts behind in Millbank and came up the line with a lock of hair in a matchbox. The men noticed at once that he polishes his buttons every evening.

On Day 10, Blackwater Canal passed to the Hegemony. Yann Bonez wrote the name in his diary with unusual care. Mail came up the line with a letter for Yann Bonez. Yann Bonez read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Yann Bonez dreamt he was back in Millbank, working as a schoolteacher. He woke up and said nothing all morning. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Yann Bonez folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
A shell hit the latrine at S-R11. Nobody was hurt. Yann Bonez says it was the best day of the war.
Yann Bonez traded a lock of hair in a matchbox for two cigarettes and immediately regretted it.
Yann Bonez spent the night filling sandbags. By dawn he could no longer close his hands. By noon the shells had emptied half of them again.

Machine-gun fire swept S-R11. Yann Bonez took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Jakub Fts of the Concord (@souza.fts.085). Yann Bonez stood up to fix a loose sandbag at S-R11. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Jakub Fts of the Concord (@souza.fts.085).
Edmund Bonez came to the front because his uncle Yann Bonez never came home. He carries a lock of hair in a matchbox.
Edmund Bonez tried to remember the price of a loaf in Millbank. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought.
aamir_pa2009: Tobias Aamir joined the replacements on Day 8. An old hand checked his pack straps before asking his name.
Tobias Aamir reads Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall's letters from home out loud, because Smokes never learned to read. Tobias leaves out the sad parts. Smokes knows.
Day 10. Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Aamir watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The sergeant at S-S2 called out a range and a spot. Tobias Aamir was the only one who hit it. Jakub Mccooper was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Tobias Aamir answered to number 574. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Tobias Aamir kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Tobias Aamir traded for a better blanket and got a reputation as a sharp dealer. The man who lost it wants a rematch.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Tobias Aamir asked if second helpings depended on the answer.
A parcel arrived tied with blue ribbon. Tobias Aamir gave the contents away and kept the ribbon to mark a page.
A bullet hit Tobias Aamir's belt buckle at S-S2 and glanced off into his side. Shallow, the medic said. He is keeping the buckle. Shot by Quentin Oorah of the Hegemony (@oorah961).
Tobias Aamir no longer winces when he lifts his rifle. The medic signed him off with a grunt.
blopa_4_you: Jakub You arrived at R-F10 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam corrected the cap; the first puddle corrected the rest.
Jakub You is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Jakub You turned a year older today. The bay sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle.

A rat stole Jakub You's cheese ration while he watched. He let it. The rat looked hungrier. Verdel Ridge is lost. Jakub You heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A loose thread in Jakub You's blanket turned out to be very long. By the time he stopped pulling, there was a hole to explain.
A shell burst in the trench at R-F10. Jakub You was thrown against the wall and did not get up. The bearers came at a run.

The bearers moved Jakub You's stretcher against the wall at midday and back again at dusk. That was the whole schedule. The Hegemony secured Hill 304. Jakub You helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.
There was never a bed for Jakub You, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to R-F10 on his own feet.
Jakub You (Hegemony) shouted a challenge across to Tobias "Smokes" Chris (Concord) at the Chalk Pits. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
A bullet clipped Jakub You's helmet at R-F10 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Ivo "Ash" Superfeisty of the Concord (@superfeisty7).
Jakub You walked back up the communication trench to R-F10, slower than before, but on his own feet.

Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Jakub You shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend. A letter from home found Jakub You before the night shift. Jakub You folded it small and kept it close.

A round went through the rim of Jakub You's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Dorian Shpkunky of the Concord (@shpkunky). Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Jakub You could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
Jakub You's bandage came off today. The scar is ugly. He is rather proud of it.

Jakub You was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at R-F10. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Quentin Joelauramorr of the Concord (@joelauramorrow). Jakub You was killed on watch at R-F10. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Quentin Joelauramorr of the Concord (@joelauramorrow).
The House of You sent another. Viktor You, older brother of Jakub You, arrived with the same eyes and the same stubborn silence.
Viktor You taught Dorian Man three words in the language of home. Dorian uses all three at the wrong moment, every day.

A bullet hit Viktor You in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at R-F10. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Gustav Egga of the Concord (@egga15627).
Someone moved Viktor You's stretcher out of the doorway. It was the most anyone did for him all day, and he was grateful.
damiendeberry: "You're late," said the corporal when Florian Damiendeberr arrived on Day 11. "Everyone's late. Get a spade." Grey Mill has been won. Florian Damiendeberr listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Florian Damiendeberr laughed at something nobody else had heard. Asked to share it, he admitted remembering a conversation from years ago. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Damiendeberr. Florian Damiendeberr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Fog so thick that Florian Damiendeberr could not see the end of his own rifle. Somewhere out there, someone was whistling. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Damiendeberr. Florian Damiendeberr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Florian Damiendeberr reached up to fix a sandbag at P-F20 and a bullet took the skin off two knuckles. The sandbag got fixed anyway. Mail came up the line with a letter for Florian Damiendeberr. Florian Damiendeberr read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Machine-gun fire swept P-F20. Florian Damiendeberr took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Henrik "Ghost" Andrewcraddo of the Concord (@andrewcraddock1980).
A medic brought Florian Damiendeberr half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
domenickiers: Quentin Domenickiers came up with a draft of replacements on Day 16. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.
fejobo: Norbert Fejobo was a tailor in Halden until the posters went up. He came to P-F3 with a lucky button, and within a day the whole squad knew that he sleeps with his boots on. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Norbert Fejobo did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.

Norbert Fejobo wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats. Mail came up the line with a letter for Norbert Fejobo. Norbert Fejobo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A sniper's bullet hit Norbert Fejobo at P-F3. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp of the Concord (@speckyjp). A single shot at P-F3. Norbert Fejobo sat down against the trench wall as if to rest, and did not get up. Shot by Oskar "Crow" Speckyjp of the Concord (@speckyjp).

Matthias Fejobo put a lucky button beside the bunk. Someone who had known Norbert Fejobo helped clear the shelf without saying why. Matthias Fejobo's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Matthias Fejobo was hit in the forearm at P-F3. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Fejobo. Matthias Fejobo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Matthias Fejobo's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at P-F3 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on. Mail came up the line with a letter for Matthias Fejobo. Matthias Fejobo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Matthias Fejobo threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Oskar Kyamites was down and screaming for a medic. (@kalamitous_kyamites) Matthias Fejobo went over with the night raiders, found the enemy trench empty at that spot, and came back with a bag of their biscuits. A round came through a gap in the sandbags at P-F3 and grazed Matthias Fejobo's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Severin Geraldkisner of the Concord (@geraldkisner). Matthias Fejobo got a letter full of small news: a new calf, a broken gate, a wedding in the spring.
gece.ds: Oskar Gece came up the line with a tin of tobacco and nothing else. The sergeant wrote him down as Private and pointed at the mud. Orders came through: Oskar Gece is a rifleman now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a tin of tobacco.

Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Oskar Gece kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand. A letter from home reached Oskar Gece before dusk. Oskar Gece read it twice and slept a little easier.

An old advertisement showed a spotless man smoking beside a fireplace. Oskar Gece added a leak above the man's head in pencil. A letter from home reached Oskar Gece before dusk. Oskar Gece read it twice and slept a little easier. The clerk counted the names twice. Oskar Gece is number 725 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Oskar Gece watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
A pocket watch went along the bench so everyone could set the time. Oskar Gece has no watch, but checked it anyway, just to feel included.

The dugout at S-C14 took a direct hit. Oskar Gece was pulled out last, still breathing. Oskar Gece was carried into the hospital dugout feet first, because that was the only way the stretcher fit through the door. Oskar Gece opened his eyes today and asked for water. At S-C14 they cheered when the news came up the line.
A medic brought Oskar Gece half a cup of soup and a promise. The soup was real.
Oskar Gece healed on a stretcher under a canvas sheet, with the bearers stepping over him day and night. He thanked each one by name before leaving.
Oskar Gece fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Valentin Cbeattie, now gravely wounded.
grizzly_ware: After 9 days of war, S-R4 had a place for everything. On Day 9, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Cyril Ware.

A bullet hit Cyril Ware in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at S-R4. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob of the Hegemony (@cornkkob). A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Cyril Ware fell at S-R4 and never moved again. Shot by Ivo "Rabbit" Cornkkob of the Hegemony (@cornkkob).

The papers connected Rafael Ware to Cyril Ware. The men took longer to learn Rafael Ware's own habits, but they made the effort. Orders came through: Rafael Ware is a machine gunner now. He handed in his old kit and kept only a frozen apple.

A bullet went through Rafael Ware's sleeve at S-R4 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. Shot by Nils Gregoriousdo of the Hegemony (@gregoriousdonder). Mail came up the line with a letter for Rafael Ware. Rafael Ware read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. The clerk counted the names twice. Rafael Ware is number 933 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Rafael Ware kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

A round came through the loophole Rafael Ware was watching at S-R4 and hit him in the collarbone. He is alive and very angry. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Soccer of the Hegemony (@cuyler_soccer26). Rafael Ware was killed outright at S-R4, a single bullet from across the wire. Shot by Henrik "Shadow" Soccer of the Hegemony (@cuyler_soccer26).
The House of Ware sent Jonas "Brick" Ware after Rafael Ware. This time the family packed two pairs of spare socks.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Jonas "Brick" Ware shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Oskar Mitaylor, was badly wounded.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A round went through Jonas "Brick" Ware's water bottle and into his thigh, but not far. He is more upset about the water. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas "Brick" Ware. Jonas "Brick" Ware read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

A bullet found Jonas "Brick" Ware at S-R4, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Zeno Emperornoble of the Hegemony (@emperornoblez). Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas "Brick" Ware. Jonas "Brick" Ware read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Jonas "Brick" Ware waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Jonas "Brick" Ware no longer needed it.
Silas Ware asked about Jonas "Brick" Ware on arriving at S-R4. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another.
kotarode: By the time Tobias "Button" Kotarode reached P-F5, the war was 11 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Tobias "Button" Kotarode helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.

Tobias "Button" Kotarode brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived. A letter from home found Tobias "Button" Kotarode before the night shift. Tobias "Button" Kotarode folded it small and kept it close.

Fog hid the far end of P-F5. Tobias "Button" Kotarode kept counting the turns so as not to walk past the dugout. A letter from home found Tobias "Button" Kotarode before the night shift. Tobias "Button" Kotarode folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias "Button" Kotarode of the Hegemony shouted across the wire at the Bone Quarry, asking for the football scores from home. Jakub Fts of the Concord shouted them back. Some of them were even true. A letter from home found Tobias "Button" Kotarode before the night shift. Tobias "Button" Kotarode folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias "Button" Kotarode (Hegemony) and Clement "Owl" Audio (Concord) were sent out to cut the other side's wire at Grey Mill on the same night. They met in the middle and agreed to go home. A letter from home found Tobias "Button" Kotarode before the night shift. Tobias "Button" Kotarode folded it small and kept it close.

Tobias "Button" Kotarode reads Viktor Thejazzbutch's letters from home out loud, because Viktor never learned to read. Button leaves out the sad parts. Viktor knows. The corporal called out the mail. Tobias "Button" Kotarode heard the name and almost ran.
le_vigneaux: Bastian Vigneaux told the sergeant he was a carpenter. The sergeant said the war needed one of those like it needed a hole in the roof, and put him on sentry.

Bastian Vigneaux saved half a biscuit for later. Later came six minutes afterwards. A letter from home found Bastian Vigneaux before the night shift. Bastian Vigneaux folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony took Grey Mill, and the orders at Q-F21 changed before the cheering ended. Bastian Vigneaux shouldered another load.

Bastian Vigneaux did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Bastian Vigneaux fired back. Gideon "Spark" Yeti was grazed. A letter from home found Bastian Vigneaux before the night shift. Bastian Vigneaux folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian Vigneaux rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Gideon "Spark" Yeti was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land. A letter from home found Bastian Vigneaux before the night shift. Bastian Vigneaux folded it small and kept it close.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Bastian Vigneaux raised his head for a heartbeat too long at Q-F21. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. A letter from home found Bastian Vigneaux before the night shift. Bastian Vigneaux folded it small and kept it close.

Bastian Vigneaux came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. A letter from home found Bastian Vigneaux before the night shift. Bastian Vigneaux folded it small and kept it close.

The flare went up just as Bastian Vigneaux reached the Concord parapet. Bastian Vigneaux jumped down first. Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston was the man waiting there, and Gideon "Mole" Isaacburston fell. (@isaacburston) The Concord sentry, Valentin Peebles, shouted once. Bastian Vigneaux silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@miles.peebles) The corporal called out the mail. Bastian Vigneaux heard the name and almost ran.
minopeo: The sergeant gave Karel Minopeo a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.

The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Blackwater Canal. Karel Minopeo read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed. A letter from home reached Karel Minopeo before dusk. Karel Minopeo read it twice and slept a little easier.

Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Karel Minopeo went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin. A letter from home reached Karel Minopeo before dusk. Karel Minopeo read it twice and slept a little easier. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached T-F7 with the rations. Karel Minopeo ate while listening to the revised orders.
Karel Minopeo checked the safety catch three times before handing over the post. The man taking over noticed, and checked it once more.

Karel Minopeo read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. A letter from home reached Karel Minopeo before dusk. Karel Minopeo read it twice and slept a little easier.
Machine-gun fire swept T-F7. Karel Minopeo took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Jakub "Doc" Colinhydee of the Hegemony (@colinhydee).

Karel Minopeo spent the day on a stretcher counting the bearers who went past. Forty-three. None of them stopped. A letter from home reached Karel Minopeo before dusk. Karel Minopeo read it twice and slept a little easier.
Karel Minopeo waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Karel Minopeo no longer needed it.
Another member of the House of Minopeo reached the line: Roland "Ghost" Minopeo. He asked where Karel Minopeo had slept, then chose a different corner.
moose_benson: At the depot, Severin Benson had practised answering to his name. At T-F16, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Severin Benson got a letter from Anna. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Severin Benson walked the captured trenches of Grey Mill and found the enemy's cooking pots still warm. He took a spoon as a souvenir.

Severin Benson was hit in the forearm at T-F16. Clean through the meat, the medic said. He asked if that was good. The medic said it was the best kind. Shot by Karel "Spark" Freejstax of the Concord (@freejstax).
The medic looked at Severin Benson's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to T-F16. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Out on the wire with the wiring party. Severin Benson felt a hard tug at his hip at T-F16. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string.
The medics cleaned Severin Benson's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at T-F16.

Severin Benson went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Dorian "Owl" Enclavecorey was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@enclavecorey05) Back from the raid, Severin Benson found a sweetheart card in a coat pocket that was not there before: 'My Pal' (common). Nobody asked where it came from.
raulrdrgzz: Casimir Raulrdrgzz arrived on Day 14 as a replacement. The men in N-F16 had been fighting for 14 days already and looked at his clean boots like a rumour from another world.
Casimir Raulrdrgzz spent an hour repairing a pocket. Nothing goes in it now without a careful inspection.
A figure ran between two enemy trenches. Casimir Raulrdrgzz aimed a step ahead and fired: Hugo Panda, gravely wounded.
seallesak: The draft reached U-F15 on Day 10. Roland Seallesak was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

Roland Seallesak agreed to sit for a portrait drawn by a man with a piece of charcoal. The first result made him look twice his age. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Roland Seallesak folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Roland Seallesak had a clear view down the enemy trench for the space of one breath. It was enough. Matthias Lukehomeless was grazed.
The artist tried again while Roland Seallesak read a letter. The new portrait was better, though the ears became the subject of discussion.
The new soap slipped into the wash bucket. Roland Seallesak fished it out by feel and then had to wash again.
Roland Seallesak sent the portrait home after asking the artist to leave the ears alone. A photograph would have cost more than he could spare.
On dawn watch at U-F15, Roland Seallesak fired at a shadow by the enemy wire. The shadow was Severin "Brick" Lukehomeless, now badly wounded.
the_great_hungarian: Bram "Bones" Hungarian left a sweetheart who has stopped writing behind in Marrow Fen and came up the line with a book with the last pages torn out. The men noticed at once that he sleeps with his boots on.
ya_man_caleb: Walter Caleb arrived with the Day 3 draft, carrying a pressed cornflower and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it.
For keeping his head when others lost theirs at Lantern Hill, Walter Caleb was promoted to Lance Corporal.
Walter Caleb polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Walter Caleb read a theatre review while peeling supper. On Day 6, Hill 304 passed to the Hegemony. Walter Caleb wrote the name in his diary with unusual care.
Walter Caleb was sent to examine a pump that worked only when struck. He asked the men to stop striking it long enough to listen.
Walter Caleb read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing.
The pump's fault proved to be a worn fitting. Walter Caleb made a replacement from scrap while the men returned to bailing by hand.
Rain blew in under the dugout door. Walter Caleb moved his boots out of the wet, then realized they were already inside.
The Concord raiders were in and out in two minutes. At S-F4 they left Walter Caleb behind, dead on the duckboards. Killed in the night raid by Severin Ricefarmer of the Concord (@dank.ricefarmer).
A letter came with Dorian Caleb: "I am Walter Caleb's father. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.

Dorian Caleb had marked the enemy's path to the latrine on a scrap of paper. Today it paid off: Jakub Khattabka, grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Dorian Caleb answered to number 230. Victory at Grey Mill. Dorian Caleb let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
A clear shot from S-F4. Dorian Caleb grazed Jakub "Crow" Corporalstar and slid back down below the parapet.
The fog lifted at noon and Dorian Caleb saw the Sunken Road clearly for the first time. He wished it had stayed.

Dawn watch. Dorian Caleb put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Tobias Jacckk, grazed. A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Dorian Caleb across the shin at S-F4. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Otto "Smokes" Ojmcfall of the Concord (@ojmcfall).
Dorian Caleb's wound has closed. He showed the scar to everyone at S-F4 until the sergeant told him to put his shirt back on.
Nobody heard the Concord raiders cut the wire. Dorian Caleb only heard boots on the duckboards at S-F4, then nothing but pain. Raider: Marek Valiantlyval of the Concord (@valiantlyvaliancy).
yeah.itz.avery: Nobody saw Viktor Avery arrive. One morning there was simply one more helmet in P-F6, and a quiet field cook under it.

Viktor Avery polished a spoon until he could see a small, bent version of his face. It looked unimpressed with supper too. Grey Mill is lost. Viktor Avery heard the news from a runner, said nothing, and checked his rifle twice. There will be another race.
A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Viktor Avery. The men named it the Judge and said it had chosen him.
the Judge the crow follows Viktor Avery along the trench now. When the Judge flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
An empty jam tin became Viktor Avery's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
Viktor Avery offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Viktor Avery was hit hard in the fight at P-F6 before anyone could fire. The raider was Walter Arcadialoren of the Hegemony. Raider: Walter Arcadialoren of the Hegemony (@arcadialoren).
